citations.desc: Environment enhancement to promote psychological well-being.
citations.narrative:
The licensee is missing a complete species-appropriate environmental enhancement plan for birds that is approved by the
attending veterinarian. The facility has a number of species of birds including vultures, owls, red tailed hawks, and a
peregrine falcon. The facility does have a written plan that addresses some social grouping and environmental
enhancements for birds, but per the conversation with the licensee, the plan has not been approved by the attending
veterinarian. In addition, the plan does not address special considerations, restraint devices, and exemptions.
A species-appropriate plan for environmental enhancement is necessary to promote the psychological well-being of the
birds on the premises. The plan needs to be approved by the attending veterinarian and must address, at a minimum,
social grouping, environmental enrichment, special considerations, restraint devices, and exemptions.
Correct by 07/23/26
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with facility representatives.
Additional Inspectors:
Kevin Wilken, ANIMAL CARE INSPECTOR n
